title: S1-016 workspace lineage invariant contract (authoritative, versioned)

concepts.runtime_scope: one canonical (tenant_id, workspace_id, goal_id) tuple per ArtifactVersion; the sole authorization filter
concepts.artifact_identity: immutable (id, version); content addressed by digest; correction = new version + supersedes
concepts.lineage_operation: append-only typed operation row with idempotency key, causal parents and scope auth context
concepts.export_representation: derived deterministic projection (PROV subset + AgentOS extension); never authority

hard_invariants.L1: single scope: every runtime ArtifactVersion has exactly one canonical (tenant_id, workspace_id, goal_id) scope
hard_invariants.L2: immutable history: content, scope and provenance of an existing version never change; correction creates a new version + supersedes
hard_invariants.L3: copy: cross-scope copy creates a new target version/object plus an explicit copy operation; the source is unchanged
hard_invariants.L4: move: move is explicit create/copy-to-target plus source withdrawal/tombstone membership event; partial execution stays visible
hard_invariants.L5: membership deletion: removal closes a membership interval or creates a deletion event, never erases insertion/provenance
hard_invariants.L6: no provenance authority: a lineage edge never widens read, write, capability, approval or policy scope
hard_invariants.L7: referential integrity: no orphan artifact/member/operation links; unknown references fail closed
hard_invariants.L8: causal integrity: operation ordering is checkable, cycle/duplicate semantics explicit, timestamps never the sole order source
hard_invariants.L9: round trip: canonical model, PROV export, validated import yield the same semantic digest over the supported subset
hard_invariants.L10: audit reconstruction: the auditor rebuilds create/insert/remove/copy/move/supersede chains from canonical events, not summaries
hard_invariants.L11: no hidden leakage: export carries no content/IDs from scopes the export request may not see; redaction stays explainable
hard_invariants.L12: atomic evidence: transition and audit/lineage event commit atomically or not at all

failure_semantics.duplicate_idempotent: single effect; replay returns the original outcome digest
failure_semantics.partial_move: observable PARTIAL state with explicit pending endpoint
failure_semantics.unsupported_prov: explicit UNSUPPORTED listing, never silent drop

forbidden: multiple simultaneous authoritative scopes on one object
authorization derived from a provenance edge

compatibility.rule: any compatibility violation fails closed (reject input)
